slot: MoR for desktop apps / licence keys / digital goods

pick.name: Dodo Payments (one-time + licence keys)
pick.what: One-time or subscription sales with licence keys (activation limits, client-side activate/validate)
pick.why: Same MoR as your SaaS = one KYC, one payout, cheaper than Polar for one-time sales (no +0.5%)
pick.free_limits: One-time: 4% + 40c (+1.5% non-US); licence keys included; activate/validate callable from client apps without API secret

alts.name: Polar (licence keys benefit)
alts.what: Licence keys with activation limits, expiry, usage quotas
alts.why: Most mature licence-key API; public activate endpoint for desktop/mobile

alts.name: Gumroad
alts.free_limits: 10% + 50c direct; 30% via Discover; MoR for sales tax since 2025-01-01

candidates.name: Paddle
candidates.verdict: No built-in licence keys in Paddle Billing (not re-verified)

candidates.name: Keygen
candidates.verdict: Licensing server to pair with any MoR (not checked)

candidates.name: Google Play Billing
candidates.verdict: Mandatory for in-app digital goods on Android: 10%+5% billing fee subs in EEA/UK/US/AU/JP (new structure), 15% elsewhere; India alt-billing 4% lower

decision: Keep desktop licences on the same MoR as SaaS to avoid a second KYC/payout stream; Dodo's licence keys cover activation limits. Use Polar if you need usage-quota keys or prefer its API. Android in-app purchases must go through Google Play Billing regardless.

verify.note: Licence-key doc: activation limits; 'The activate, deactivate, and validate license endpoints are public and don't require an API key.' Gumroad 10% + 50c direct, 30% Discover, MoR since 2025-01-01 confirmed. The same INR-wallet correction as the SaaS MoR slot applies.
